items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: the man had heard about me, by the name of Louis T. Nicholson is the name... So he asked me to take it.

ctx.x: Well, when you get down here then, Arnett, what do you do then, when you get here?

I come into Houston in June, and I worked around, I formed a band here. But around the corner here [in the Curbette that was in,] the man had heard about me, by the name of Louis T. Nicholson is the name. So he says to everybody in the neighborhood wanting to know about me. People that had run the club for him, a man and his daddy, they had ripped him off for some money, but I didn't know this. So he asked me to take it.
So my wife and I took it over in January, 1960.
